title: Data Analyst
description: A practical roadmap for becoming a data analyst: Excel, SQL, statistics, Python, dashboards, business communication, and portfolio projects.

tree.name: Data Thinking and Spreadsheet Foundations
tree.description: Learn how analysts ask business questions, inspect datasets, clean messy data, and turn raw numbers into decisions.

resources.title: Data Analyst Roadmap from Zero to Hero (Krish Naik)

children.name: Business Questions and Metrics
children.description: Translate vague requests into metrics, dimensions, cohorts, funnels, segments, and decision-ready analysis plans.

children.name: Excel and Data Cleaning
children.description: Use sorting, filters, pivots, lookups, conditional logic, cleaning rules, validation, and reproducible workbook habits.

tree.name: SQL, Statistics, and Python Analysis
tree.description: Build the core analysis engine: query databases, summarize distributions, test assumptions, and analyze with Python.

children.name: SQL for Analysis
children.description: Practice joins, grouping, CTEs, windows, date logic, subqueries, case statements, and query review habits.

children.name: Statistics and Experiments
children.description: Understand descriptive stats, probability, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, correlation, and experiment traps.

children.name: Practice: SQL Insight Sprint
children.description: Answer 12 stakeholder questions from one dataset, save every query, explain assumptions, and rank insights by business impact.

tree.name: Visualization and BI Dashboards
tree.description: Create clear dashboards that reveal trends, variance, outliers, targets, and actions without overwhelming stakeholders.

resources.title: Power BI Full Course with Projects (WsCube Tech)
Prepare Data for Analysis with Power BI (Microsoft Learn)

children.name: Power BI and DAX
children.description: Model relationships, clean in Power Query, write DAX measures, build slicers, publish reports, and document refresh logic.

children.name: Data Storytelling
children.description: Choose the right chart, write crisp titles, annotate changes, show uncertainty, and present recommendations clearly.

tree.name: Portfolio, Domain Context, and Interviews
tree.description: Turn practice into proof: publish dashboards, case studies, notebooks, resumes, and interview-ready explanations.

resources.title: Power BI Full Course with Practical Projects (WsCube Tech)

children.name: Domain Analytics
children.description: Study metrics for product, finance, sales, marketing, operations, and support so your analysis fits real business contexts.

children.name: Project: Executive Analytics Dashboard
children.description: Build a dashboard from raw CSV or database data, include SQL/Python cleaning, define KPIs, and write a one-page business memo.
